description: This file defines higher-order operator classes and functions for wrapping and managing execution modes in PyTorch, including mechanisms for checkpointing, inductor compilation, autocasting, and Dynamo tracing bypass. It is part of the internal PyTorch compilation and execution infrastructure.

classes.name: Wrap
classes.description: A higher-order operator for wrapping functions, used for testing the HigherOrderOperator mechanism.

classes.name: InductorCompiledCode
classes.description: A higher-order operator for wrapping inductor compiled functions, redirecting various torch dispatch modes.

classes.name: WrapWithSetGradEnabled
classes.description: A higher-order operator that wraps a function with a context that sets the gradient enabled state.

classes.name: WrapWithAutocast
classes.description: A higher-order operator that wraps a function with autocast context for mixed precision.

classes.name: DynamoBypassingWrapper
classes.description: A higher-order operator that bypasses Dynamo tracing for a wrapped function.

classes.name: WrapActivationCheckpoint
classes.description: A higher-order operator for wrapping checkpointed functions, adding tags for activation checkpointing.

classes.name: TagActivationCheckpoint
classes.description: An operator that tags nodes in a graph module for activation checkpointing, used with torch.compile.

methods.name: inductor_compiled_code_impl
methods.description: Implementation of inductor_compiled_code for a specific dispatch key.

methods.name: inductor_compiled_code_fake
methods.description: Fake implementation that raises an error if inductor compiled code is run with FakeTensor inputs.

methods.name: tag_activation_checkpoint_impl
methods.description: Function that tags nodes in a graph module for activation checkpointing, handling context and node metadata.
